items.name: Allied Hunter
items.subtitle: Small or Medium Beast
items.hp: 20 (Air only) or 30 (Land and Water only) + 10 per spell level above 3
items.speed: 30 ft.; Climb 30 ft. (Land only); Fly 40 ft. (Air only); Swim 30 ft. (Water only)
items.skills: Stealth +1 plus PB, Survival +2 plus PB
items.crDisplay: None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

traits.name: Cunning Ally
entries: The hunter has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature that has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, or {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions, or that is under the effects of a curse you place or a curse spell you cast.

traits.name: Curse Eater
entries: Once per turn, when the hunter deals damage to a creature that is under the effects of a curse you place or a curse spell you cast, the hunter regains Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Aquatic Adaptation (Water Only)
entries: The hunter can breathe only underwater. It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws that rely on Dexterity while in aquatic environments.

traits.name: Evasion (Air Only)
entries: When the hunter is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Tenacious (Land Only)
entries: The hunter has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
entries: The hunter makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level, rounded down.

attackEntries: {@atk m} {@hitYourSpellAttack|your spell attack modifier}, reach 5 ft.
hitEntries: {@h} {@damage 1d8} + 4 + the spell's level Piercing damage, and if the hunter's environment is Land, the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC).

traits.name: Fickle Readiness
entries: When the chronopath rolls initiative, they can switch the initiative count of two creatures they can see within 90 feet of them that rolled initiative at the same time as the chronopath.

spellcasting.name: Powers
entries: In addition to the other powers in this stat block, the chronopath can manifest the following powers, using Intelligence as their manifestation ability (power save {@dc 15}):
At will: {@psionic illuminator|TalPsi}, {@psionic shared thoughts|TalPsi}
3/day each: {@psionic extinguish|TalPsi}, {@psionic penetrating sight|TalPsi}, {@psionic read object|TalPsi}, {@psionic read thoughts|TalPsi}
1/day each: {@psionic memory gap|TalPsi}, {@psionic restore the past|TalPsi}, {@psionic reveal the path|TalPsi}

actions.name: Psionic Bolt (1st-Order Power)
entries: {@atk rp} +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are pushed 5 feet away from the chronopath.

actions.name: Intuition (3/Day; 2nd-Order Power; Concentration)
entries: The chronopath gifts precognitive insight to up to three willing creatures within 30 feet of them that they can see.
For 1 minute, each time a target takes damage, the damage is reduced by {@dice 1d4} (minimum 0 damage).

actions.name: Witness Demise (3/Day; 5th-Order Power)
entries: The chronopath chooses up to three creatures they can see within 30 feet of them, each of which must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) psychic damage and is {@condition frightened} of the chronopath for 1 minute. On a success, a target takes half as much damage and is not {@condition frightened}.

bonusActions.name: Time Thief (1st-Order Power)
entries: The chronopath chooses a creature within 30 feet of them, which must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 3d4}) necrotic damage. The chronopath gains temporary hit points equal to the damage taken.

entries: When the chronopath or a creature they can see within 30 feet of them misses with an attack roll, the chronopath momentarily rewinds time. The attacker can reroll the attack and must use the new roll.
